rule: Reject an aggregate pair exactly when sum > 0 and max == 0.
candidate_selection: native valid in its saved population geometry
original initially detected and candidate predicted benign
for added-rule policy: no positive-sum/zero-max pair
rank by malicious probability, distance, source path, local candidate index
recheck assembled final matrix; advance rejected candidates, otherwise use original
pool_scope: All exported final-stage populations and each method's saved effective final output; not unexported intermediate optimizer vectors. End-only methods also retain original CAA sources. In-loop standalone policies do not include union-with-original outputs.
protocol_timing: Specified after notebook 06's exploratory diagnostic; frozen before notebook 07 clean-control audit. This is a post-hoc development audit, not a preregistered independent test.
source_lineage: Linked by serval-uni-lu/realistic_adversarial_hardening, whose CTU preprocessing lineage is described in TabularBench documentation. Exact reproduction of the pinned benchmark CSV from this extractor is not established.
source_semantics: The extractor updates each sum and maximum from the same nonnegative observations.
Aggregates are grouped by internal host, time window, destination-port bucket and connection endpoint role.
s denotes internal originator/source; d denotes internal responder/destination.
Missing '-' observations are converted to zero; empty aggregate buckets start at zero.
tcp_sum, udp_sum and icmp_sum accumulate bytes, not connection counts.
The extractor supports multiple window sizes; the pinned CSV window length and duration unit lineage are not independently established here.
limitations: Passing this one necessary condition is not sufficient for packet realizability or malicious functionality.
No arbitrary duration cap, byte equality, connection-count inference or generator repair is added.
No attacks, model training, threshold tuning or live packet experiments are performed.
Only native train/development rows are parsed for clean auditing; full asset hashing reads bytes without evaluating native test records.
The frozen checkpoint compatibility scaler was fitted on all feature rows in the earlier experiment; this inherited limitation remains.
If clean controls violate this rule, retain and report them; do not adjust thresholds, remove records or claim physical validity.
Repeated seeds reuse the same original records and are not independent population samples.
